rule: additive successor. The base package is not rewritten and its digest stands. This record extends it.

anomalies.what: derive-231-authoritative-state.ts was first run leaving G11-E1 as ran=false, match=null, because the exercise could not run when nothing was admitted to the ledger. It was then patched to compare the non-run against the frozen expectation.
anomalies.whyItIsNotAThresholdChange: The frozen G11-E1 expectation already states that nothing enters the ledger and that the absence is the point: humanPropertyAction NONE, humanEvidenceAction NONE, expectedLedgerTransitions 0, expectedSettlementApplied false, expectedEvidenceAuthorityMinted false, expectedFactStatusAfter UNRESOLVED and expectedRefusalCodes FACT_NOT_IN_LEDGER. The patch implements that frozen expectation; it does not alter it. The same pattern is present in the derivation script §228B used.
anomalies.guardApplied: The leniency is gated on the frozen expectation itself matching the nothing-in-ledger shape. G4, G6 and C4, where the non-run was caused by an upstream failure denying a real settlement path its opportunity, remain NOT_EXERCISED and are never credited as passes.
anomalies.effectOnTheDecision: None. G11 is not among the frozen cases for HS4, HS5, HS6 or Q11, so G11-J5 contributes to no gate or measure either way. The three gates that fail do so on other cases.

anomalies.what: The §229 candidate baseline carries a sourceTree digest a50b4ad23e973a4747e74dea93d85463c3c3f382278cfff7063d4866c3fad4cd over 46 runtime modules and 166 contract modules. The script that computed it was not retained in the repository and the digest could not be independently recomputed.
anomalies.whatWasVerifiedInstead: File-set cardinality matches exactly at 46 runtime and 166 contract modules, the 167th contract module being the §230 instrument added after the baseline was frozen. The 29-module protected composite identity recomputed to 37ce9eb8e9db62288b0a4953072bb487f38beab962d4716ad74be47036e2e2cb, matching the baseline, with zero modules missing. The §229 protected ladder passed 17 of 17. The production typecheck passed. Both frozen manifests verified clean.
anomalies.effectOnTheDecision: None, but it is a real gap in reproducible provenance and should be closed by retaining the builder script before any future baseline is frozen.

anomalies.what: §230 froze the instrument, the cohort, the truth, the slots, the gates and the call plan, but did not freeze an execution harness. The §231 assembly, executor, derivation, packet emitter and scorer were written at execution time.
anomalies.constraintsHonoured: The assembly is a transcription of the §228B assembly onto the §230 cases through the same 29 protected modules in the same order. The executor refuses to transmit unless the candidate baseline, the frozen instrument digest, the frozen package digest and the 29-module composite identity all match, and it verifies per case that the transmitted observation is the frozen observation. No case, truth, expectation, threshold, denominator or scoring rule was authored, altered or inferred by the harness.
anomalies.effectOnTheDecision: The harness determines how the frozen instrument is executed, not what it measures. Recorded so a reader can judge that for themselves.

anomalies.what: 52 primary calls were planned and 49 were drawn. The three undrawn legs are the verifier calls for G4, G6 and C4.
anomalies.why: On each of those cases the first pass admitted no declaration, so the §218 verifier had no target to review. This is a result of the run, not a coverage reduction: no leg was skipped to remain under the projected spend and the frozen coverage was not reduced.
anomalies.spend: USD 3.4906 against a projected USD 3.6328 and a hard ceiling of USD 4.28. The ceiling was never approached and no additional authorization was required.
